name: multipliers-windows-clamped-low
description: A 10 day plant (let_top_dry) in a 15 cm pot in direct light: the product 0.4 is held to 0.6, so the working interval is 6 days, not 4. Watered on 2026-11-02.
why: Clamp to 0.6 of the catalogue interval. 10 x 0.6 = 6 days; band 25% early (round half up of 1.5 = 2) and 25% late (2): earliest 2026-11-02 + 6 - 2 = 2026-11-06, latest + 6 + 2 = 2026-11-10. Hand computation.
